components.name: Box

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: as
props.desc: The rendered element (div/section/aside/span/…).

props.name: pad
props.desc: Inner padding — a rung/px, or a [block, inline] pair.

props.name: bg
props.desc: Background color/token.

props.name: border
props.desc: true → --stroke, soft → --stroke-soft, or a color → 1px solid <color>.

props.name: radius
props.desc: Corner radius rung (--r-*) or raw px.

props.name: shadow
props.desc: Elevation (--shadow-*).

whenUse: The generic styled container — any div you'd otherwise write raw.
Applying token padding / bg / border / radius / shadow.
whenNot: A flex row or column — use Row / Stack.
Text — use Text.

components.name: Stack

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: gap
props.desc: Gap between children — a rung (xs…xl) or raw px.

props.name: align
props.desc: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: justify
props.desc: Main-axis distribution.

props.name: wrap
props.desc: Allow children to wrap onto multiple lines.

props.name: pad
props.desc: Inner padding — a rung/px, or a [block, inline] pair.

props.name: inline
props.desc: Render as inline-flex instead of flex.

whenUse: Stacking children vertically with a consistent gap.
A form or a labelled list column.
whenNot: A horizontal cluster — use Row.
A 2-D layout with tracks — use Grid.

components.name: Row

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: gap
props.desc: Gap between children — a rung (xs…xl) or raw px.

props.name: align
props.desc: Cross-axis alignment.

props.name: justify
props.desc: Main-axis distribution.

props.name: wrap
props.desc: Allow children to wrap onto multiple lines.

props.name: pad
props.desc: Inner padding — a rung/px, or a [block, inline] pair.

props.name: inline
props.desc: Render as inline-flex instead of flex.

whenUse: Laying items in a horizontal line with a gap.
A header / toolbar cluster (pair with Spacer to push trailing items).
whenNot: A vertical column — use Stack.
Aligned tabular data — use Grid.

components.name: Spacer

props.name: size
props.desc: A rigid spacer of this size; omit for a greedy flex:1 filler.

whenUse: Pushing trailing items to the far edge of a Row (greedy flex:1).
A fixed rigid gap between two specific items.
whenNot: Even spacing between many children — use the parent's gap.
Inner padding — use pad.

components.name: Grid

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: cols
props.desc: Columns — a number → repeat(n, 1fr), or a gridTemplateColumns string.

props.name: rows
props.desc: Rows — a number → repeat(n, 1fr), or a gridTemplateRows string.

props.name: gap
props.desc: Gap between children — a rung (xs…xl) or raw px.

props.name: align
props.desc: Cell cross-axis alignment (alignItems).

props.name: justify
props.desc: Inline-axis track distribution (justifyContent).

props.name: inline
props.desc: Render as inline-grid instead of grid.

whenUse: A 2-D layout with explicit column / row tracks.
A responsive card or tile grid.
whenNot: A single row or column — use Row / Stack.
One-off positioning — use Box.

components.name: SectionHeader

props.name: title
props.desc: Section title (uppercase h3).

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed inline sub-text after the title.

props.name: meta
props.desc: Right-aligned dim mono text (e.g. a count).

props.name: right
props.desc: Right-aligned raw content (input/button) — overrides meta.

props.name: titleStyle
props.desc: Inline style for the title element.

whenUse: A titled section heading with an optional trailing control.
The head of a settings or card group.
whenNot: A page title — that's screen chrome.
A bare eyebrow label — use SectionLabel.

components.name: SectionLabel

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: size
props.desc: md (10px/.06em) or sm (9px/.08em, denser KPI tiles); a raw px number is also legal (dense .08em tracking).

props.name: tone
props.desc: Label color.

props.name: right
props.desc: Right-aligned slot — renders a space-between label row (label · right); style then lands on the row.

whenUse: A small uppercase eyebrow labelling a group.
A field-group or list-section caption.
whenNot: A full heading with actions — use SectionHeader.
Body copy — use Text.

components.name: Dialog

props.name: title
props.desc: Dialog heading.

props.name: children
props.desc: Body content.

props.name: actions
props.desc: Footer action buttons (right-aligned).

props.name: onDismiss
props.desc: Escape / scrim-click dismiss handler.

props.name: danger
props.desc: Red heading + border for a destructive confirm.

whenUse: A focused, blocking task (confirm or short form).
Content that must be dismissed before continuing.
whenNot: Non-blocking info — use a Banner / toast.
A large multi-step flow — use a page / stage.
components.srcText:
import { Dialog } from "@/shared/ui/overlay/Dialog";

<Dialog title={…} actions={…} onDismiss={…}>…</Dialog>

components.name: ModalScrim

props.name: children
props.desc: The centered modal card.

props.name: onDismiss
props.desc: Escape / scrim-click dismiss; omit to make it non-dismissable.

props.name: align
props.desc: Center the card, or top-align it for tall scrolling modals.

props.name: blur
props.desc: Add a backdrop blur.

whenUse: The dimmed, click-to-dismiss backdrop behind a modal surface.
Trapping focus under a Dialog.
whenNot: A non-modal overlay — use a positioned Box.
The whole modal — compose this inside a Dialog / ModalCard.

components.name: ModalCard

props.name: title
props.desc: Head title (mono h2).

props.name: children
props.desc: Body content (scrolls).

props.name: sub
props.desc: Dim sub-line under the title.

props.name: icon
props.desc: Leading head glyph in a 30px IconBox.

props.name: iconBackground
props.desc: Icon tile background (default: translucent accent).

props.name: iconColor
props.desc: Icon glyph color (default: accent).

props.name: onClose
props.desc: Wires the head ✕ + Escape + scrim-click dismiss; omit for non-dismissable.

props.name: busy
props.desc: Disable the ✕ and suppress scrim/Escape dismiss while an op runs.

props.name: width
props.desc: Card width (px or CSS length); capped at 100%.

props.name: maxHeight
props.desc: Card max height.

props.name: align
props.desc: Scrim card alignment — start top-aligns tall scrolling modals.

props.name: blur
props.desc: Backdrop blur.

props.name: headExtra
props.desc: Extra head rows (search/tabs/meta) inside the bordered head block.

props.name: foot
props.desc: Footer action-row content.

props.name: bodyStyle
props.desc: Merged onto the body (padding/overflow overrides for list bodies).

props.name: footStyle
props.desc: Merged onto the foot row.

whenUse: A rich titled modal — icon + title head, scrollable body, footer action row.
A multi-section overlay (import/share flows, per-session pickers) that outgrows Dialog.
whenNot: A short confirm or one-field form — use Dialog.
Non-blocking info — use a Banner / toast.

components.name: Text

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: size
props.desc: Font size — a rung (xxs…xl) or raw px. Omit to inherit.

props.name: tone
props.desc: Semantic color tone. Omit to inherit.

props.name: mono
props.desc: Apply the mono (JetBrains Mono) utility class.

props.name: weight
props.desc: Font weight — a number (500/600) or CSS keyword.

props.name: as
props.desc: The rendered element (span/div/p/label/h1–h4…).

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the text loading — an inline shimmer line the height of the text (#2302).

whenUse: Any text — sized by rung, semantically toned, mono or not.
Labels, values, and body copy.
whenNot: A raw string in a slot that already styles its text.
An interactive label — pair it with a control.

components.name: Button

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: variant
props.desc: Visual weight.

props.name: size
props.desc: Control height.

props.name: danger
props.desc: Destructive (red) styling.

whenUse: A single, discrete action the user can take.
Form submit / primary CTA (use variant="primary", one per view).
Inline row actions (use variant="ghost").
whenNot: Navigating between views — use a link.
Toggling a persistent on/off state — use Toggle.

components.name: IconButton

props.name: children
props.desc: The glyph; defaults to the close ✕.

props.name: onClick
props.desc: Click handler.

props.name: size
props.desc: Button + glyph size.

props.name: danger
props.desc: Destructive (red) hover.

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable the button.

props.name: title
props.desc: Native tooltip / aria title.

whenUse: A compact glyph-only action (close, more, expand).
A dense toolbar where a text label won't fit.
whenNot: A labelled action — use Button.
A persistent on/off state — use Toggle.

components.name: Checkbox

props.name: checked
props.desc: Checked state.

props.name: onChange
props.desc: Toggle handler.

props.name: size
props.desc: Box size in px.

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable the control.

whenUse: A single boolean in a form or list row.
Multi-select where each item is independently on/off.
whenNot: A prominent on/off switch — use Toggle.
Mutually-exclusive options — use SegmentedControl.

components.name: Toggle

props.name: on
props.desc: On state.

props.name: onClick
props.desc: Toggle handler.

props.name: size
props.desc: Switch size.

props.name: tone
props.desc: On-state color.

whenUse: An immediate on/off switch (a setting that applies at once).
A prominent binary state.
whenNot: A form value submitted later — use Checkbox.
More than two states — use SegmentedControl.

components.name: SegmentedControl

props.name: options
props.desc: SegOption[] — { label, on, onClick, tone?, dot?, title? }.

props.name: variant
props.desc: Spacing style.

props.name: size
props.desc: Control height.

props.name: label
props.desc: An optional leading label.

whenUse: 2–4 mutually-exclusive options (mode / scope).
A multi-toggle where each option holds its own state.
whenNot: Many options (>5) — use a select.
A single on/off — use Toggle.

components.name: TextField

props.name: value
props.desc: Input value.

props.name: onChange
props.desc: (value) => void.

props.name: label
props.desc: Field label.

props.name: hint
props.desc: Sub-label hint.

props.name: trailing
props.desc: Right-aligned control in the label row.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the field loading — keep the label, skeleton the input (#2302).

whenUse: Any single-line text input with a label.
Controlled form fields (value + onChange).
whenNot: Multi-line input — use TextArea.
A boolean — use Toggle / Checkbox.

components.name: TextArea

props.name: value
props.desc: Textarea value.

props.name: onChange
props.desc: (value) => void.

props.name: label
props.desc: Field label.

props.name: hint
props.desc: Sub-label hint.

props.name: trailing
props.desc: Right-aligned control in the label row.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the field loading — keep the label, skeleton the textarea (#2302).

whenUse: Any multi-line text input with a label (prompts, bodies, notes).
Controlled form fields (value + onChange) that span lines.
whenNot: Single-line input — use TextField.
Read-only code / prompt display — use Code.

components.name: SelectField

props.name: value
props.desc: Selected value.

props.name: onChange
props.desc: (value) => void.

props.name: children
props.desc: The <option> elements.

props.name: label
props.desc: Field label.

props.name: hint
props.desc: Sub-label hint.

whenUse: Choosing one option from a longer fixed list (>4).
A labelled dropdown inside a form.
whenNot: 2–4 options — use SegmentedControl.
Free text — use TextField.

components.name: BackButton

props.name: onClick
props.desc: Click handler.

props.name: aria-label
props.desc: Screen-reader label — required (the bare chevron has no text).

props.name: variant
props.desc: Boxed 30×30 chevron (icon) vs chevron + text label (text).

props.name: label
props.desc: Text-variant label after the chevron (ignored for icon).

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable the button.

props.name: size
props.desc: Chevron size in px (default 18 icon / 14 text).

props.name: title
props.desc: Native tooltip.

whenUse: Returning to the previous view within a screen.
A detail → list back affordance.
whenNot: App-level navigation — use the Rail.
A generic action — use Button.

components.name: ColorSwatch

props.name: color
props.desc: Fill color — any CSS color incl. var()/color-mix().

props.name: size
props.desc: Square side in px.

props.name: radius
props.desc: Corner radius in px.

whenUse: Picking or displaying a color / token value.
A keyed color in a legend or settings row.
whenNot: A live status color — use StatusDot.
A category label — use Chip.

components.name: ConfirmButton

props.name: label
props.desc: Resting label.

props.name: armedLabel
props.desc: Label shown once armed (after the first click).

props.name: onConfirm
props.desc: Fired on the confirming second click.

props.name: size
props.desc: Control size — md (reset cards) or sm (inline row actions).

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Disable + dim the button.

props.name: danger
props.desc: Red (destructive) styling when armed.

whenUse: A destructive action that needs an in-place two-step confirm.
Delete / reset where a Dialog is too heavy.
whenNot: A safe, single-step action — use Button.
A blocking decision with context — use Dialog.
components.srcText:
import { ConfirmButton } from "@/shared/ui/controls/ConfirmButton";

<ConfirmButton label={…} armedLabel={…} onConfirm={…} />

components.name: Card

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: title
props.desc: Canonical head title (h3).

props.name: hint
props.desc: Inline hint beside the title.

props.name: right
props.desc: Right-aligned control in the head row.

props.name: header
props.desc: A fully-custom header node (wins over title).

props.name: tone
props.desc: Border accent color.

props.name: interactive
props.desc: Hover/press affordance.

props.name: pad
props.desc: Compact padding.

props.name: onClick
props.desc: Click handler (implies interactive).

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the card loading — a skeleton body the shape of its content (#2302).

whenUse: Group related content in a framed surface.
A selectable item in a list (interactive).
whenNot: Full-bleed page sections — cards imply containment.
A modal — use Dialog.

components.name: Chip

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: tone
props.desc: Semantic color.

props.name: color
props.desc: Custom color (overrides tone).

props.name: dot
props.desc: Show a leading status dot.

props.name: size
props.desc: Chip size.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the chip loading — a shimmer pill (#2302).

whenUse: A short, non-interactive status or category label.
Dynamic colors (GitHub labels) via the color prop.
whenNot: A clickable filter — use SegmentedControl.
Long text — chips are single-line.

components.name: StatTile

props.name: k
props.desc: The label.

props.name: v
props.desc: The value.

props.name: sub
props.desc: A sub-line under the value.

props.name: tone
props.desc: Value color.

whenUse: A single key / value metric with an optional sub-line.
A compact KPI in a row of stats.
whenNot: A trend over time — use a chart.
A large headline number — use Text.

components.name: FillBar

props.name: value
props.desc: Fill amount (0–1 fraction).

props.name: color
props.desc: Fill color.

props.name: track
props.desc: Track (background) color.

props.name: height
props.desc: Bar height in px.

props.name: rounded
props.desc: Round the ends.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the bar loading — an indeterminate shimmer track (#2302).

whenUse: A horizontal progress / proportion bar (0–1 fraction).
A budget or usage meter.
whenNot: A precise value — pair it with a label.
A time series — use a chart.

components.name: Code

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: maxHeight
props.desc: Max scroll height in px.

props.name: wrap
props.desc: Soft-wrap long lines vs a horizontal scroll.

props.name: tone
props.desc: Foreground color tone.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render the block loading — shimmer lines inside the frame (#2302).

whenUse: A read-only, scrollable monospace code / prompt block.
Showing a command, config, or source snippet.
whenNot: Editable code — use an editor.
Inline mono text — use Text mono.

components.name: Avatar

props.name: login
props.desc: GitHub login — its initial on a login-hashed color.

props.name: size
props.desc: Diameter in px.

props.name: palette
props.desc: Use the discrete assignee-stack palette instead of the continuous login hue.

props.name: bordered
props.desc: 1.5px canvas ring so overlapping avatars read as separate disks.

props.name: ml
props.desc: Left margin — negative for overlapping assignee stacks.

props.name: fontScale
props.desc: Initial font size as a fraction of size.

whenUse: A person / agent identity glyph or initials.
A compact author or owner marker in a row.
whenNot: A live status indicator — use StatusDot.
A category tag — use Chip.

components.name: IconBox

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: size
props.desc: Square side in px.

props.name: radius
props.desc: Corner radius in px.

props.name: background
props.desc: Background color.

props.name: color
props.desc: Foreground color.

props.name: fontSize
props.desc: Glyph font size in px.

props.name: fontWeight
props.desc: Glyph font weight.

props.name: border
props.desc: Full border shorthand (e.g. 1px solid …).

whenUse: A framed icon tile — a leading glyph on a surface.
The icon slot of a card or empty state.
whenNot: A clickable icon — use IconButton.
A bare inline glyph — use Text.

components.name: CardListRow

props.name: title
props.desc: Primary label.

props.name: lead
props.desc: 18px lead column — a status dot, icon, or avatar.

props.name: badge
props.desc: A pill next to the title (left of the spacer).

props.name: titleAside
props.desc: Right-aligned element on the title line.

props.name: subtitle
props.desc: Secondary line under the title.

props.name: body
props.desc: Full-width rich content below the header line.

props.name: trailing
props.desc: Trailing (auto-width) column — chips, counts, controls.

props.name: selected
props.desc: Selection highlight.

props.name: off
props.desc: Dimmed/disabled look.

props.name: variant
props.desc: Bordered card vs borderless top-separated group row.

props.name: accent
props.desc: Left-rail accent color shown when selected.

props.name: onClick
props.desc: Click handler (adds a clickable affordance).

whenUse: A selectable row in a card-style list.
A master-list item with a leading glyph + trailing meta.
whenNot: A dense table row — use DataTableRow.
A standalone card — use Card.

components.name: DataTableRow

props.name: template
props.desc: grid-template-columns — share with the DataTableHeader so cells align under labels.

props.name: children
props.desc: Cell content, one node per column.

props.name: index
props.desc: Row index — odd rows get a zebra-stripe when provided.

props.name: selected
props.desc: Selection highlight.

props.name: off
props.desc: Dimmed/disabled look.

props.name: onClick
props.desc: Click handler.

props.name: height
props.desc: Fixed row height in px.

whenUse: A row in a dense, column-aligned data table.
Tabular records with fixed columns.
whenNot: A card-style list — use CardListRow.
A single metric — use StatTile.

components.name: RoleTierChips

props.name: role
props.desc: The SessionRole whose capability floor to render (planner/worker/director/…).

whenUse: Showing a session role's permission floor (git · github · code · net) as pills.
A persona/position clearance row in an editor or inspector.
whenNot: Arbitrary tags or categories — use Chip.
A single live status — use StatusDot.

components.name: StatCard

props.name: k
props.desc: The stat label.

props.name: v
props.desc: The stat value.

props.name: sub
props.desc: A sub-line under the value.

props.name: tone
props.desc: Value color tone.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Render value + sub as shimmer placeholders while the metric loads (#2234).

whenUse: A framed metric card — label, value, optional trend.
A dashboard KPI tile.
whenNot: A bare inline stat — use StatTile.
A full chart — use a chart primitive.

components.name: LineArea

props.name: series
props.desc: LineSeries[] — { name, color, data:number[], width?, dash?, dots?, fill?, dotR? }.

props.name: labels
props.desc: X-axis labels (string[]), one per data point.

props.name: height
props.desc: Chart height in px.

props.name: yMax
props.desc: Fixed y-axis max (else derived from the data).

props.name: area
props.desc: Fill the area under each series.

props.name: fmtY
props.desc: Format a y value for the axis + tooltip.

whenUse: A trend over continuous time, with the area emphasizing magnitude.
A single series where the shape matters more than exact points.
whenNot: Comparing discrete categories — use Bars.
A tiny inline glyph — use Spark.

components.name: Bars

props.name: groups
props.desc: BarGroup[] — { name, color, data:number[] }.

props.name: labels
props.desc: X-axis labels (string[]), one per bucket.

props.name: height
props.desc: Chart height in px.

props.name: stacked
props.desc: Stack the groups instead of clustering them.

props.name: fmtY
props.desc: Format a y value for the axis + tooltip.

whenUse: Comparing a value across a small set of categories.
A discrete, labelled distribution (per-day, per-stream counts).
whenNot: A trend over continuous time — use LineArea/Spark.
Parts of a whole — use Donut.

components.name: Donut

props.name: slices
props.desc: DonutSlice[] — { name, value, color }.

props.name: size
props.desc: Diameter in px.

props.name: thickness
props.desc: Ring thickness in px.

whenUse: Parts of a whole at a glance (a few large segments).
A single proportion with a centered value.
whenNot: Many small slices (hard to compare) — use HBars.
A trend — use LineArea.

components.name: HBars

props.name: rows
props.desc: HBarRow[] — { label, value, color?, strong?, icon?, tag? }.

props.name: fmtV
props.desc: Format a row value.

props.name: max
props.desc: Fixed bar max (else the largest row value).

whenUse: Ranking categories with long labels (labels read left-to-right).
A leaderboard or top-N breakdown.
whenNot: Many categories that scroll — use a table.
A time series — use LineArea.

components.name: Swimlane

props.name: lanes
props.desc: SwimLane[] — { name, color? }.

props.name: events
props.desc: SwimEvent[] — { lane, t0, t1?, color, label, r? } (t in 0–1).

props.name: height
props.desc: Lane height in px.

props.name: marks
props.desc: SwimMark[] — { t, label } vertical time markers.

whenUse: Per-lane activity across a shared horizontal axis (streams over time).
A timeline where each row is an independent track.
whenNot: A single aggregate series — use LineArea.
Category totals — use Bars.

components.name: Spark

props.name: data
props.desc: The numeric series (number[]) — needs ≥2 points.

props.name: color
props.desc: Line / fill color.

props.name: w
props.desc: Width in px.

props.name: h
props.desc: Height in px.

props.name: fill
props.desc: Fill under the line.

props.name: dot
props.desc: Show a dot at the last point.

whenUse: A tiny inline trend beside a metric (no axes).
A dense row/tile where a full chart won't fit.
whenNot: A chart the user must read precisely — use LineArea with axes.
Category comparison — use Bars.

components.name: Legend

props.name: items
props.desc: LegendItem[] — { color, label, value? }.

whenUse: Keying a chart's colors to their meaning.
A compact color↔label index beside a graph.
whenNot: A clickable filter — use SegmentedControl / Chips.
Status on one item — use StatusDot.

components.name: StackedDayBars

props.name: data
props.desc: StackedDay[] — { day, upper, lower }.

props.name: title
props.desc: Card title.

props.name: subtitle
props.desc: Card subtitle.

props.name: upperLabel
props.desc: Legend label for the upper (top) series.

props.name: lowerLabel
props.desc: Legend label for the lower (baseline) series.

props.name: upperColor
props.desc: Upper series color.

props.name: lowerColor
props.desc: Lower series color.

whenUse: A per-day total split into composition segments (a stacked column per day).
Daily volume with a status/category breakdown.
whenNot: A single continuous line — use LineArea.
One category only — use Bars.
components.srcText:
import { StackedDayBars } from "@/shared/ui/charts/Charts";

<StackedDayBars data={…} title={…} subtitle={…} upperLabel={…} lowerLabel={…} />

components.name: Banner

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: tone
props.desc: Semantic color.

props.name: variant
props.desc: Inline chip vs full-width bar.

props.name: lead
props.desc: Leading icon/label.

props.name: dot
props.desc: Show a leading status dot.

props.name: loud
props.desc: Stronger emphasis.

props.name: right
props.desc: Right-aligned content.

props.name: onDismiss
props.desc: Show a dismiss ✕ and call this.

whenUse: An inline or full-width status message with a tone.
A dismissible notice above content.
whenNot: A blocking decision — use Dialog.
A short inline error — use InlineError.

components.name: InlineError

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

props.name: pad
props.desc: Inner padding — a rung/px or a [block, inline] pair.

props.name: radius
props.desc: Corner radius rung (--r-*) or raw px.

props.name: borderFade
props.desc: Border tint — transparency % of --danger in the 1px border (some sites use 60).

whenUse: A short static error string on a danger wash.
A field- or section-level failure note.
whenNot: A dismissible page notice — use Banner.
A blocking error — use Dialog.

components.name: EmptyState

props.name: title
props.desc: The headline.

props.name: description
props.desc: Supporting copy.

props.name: icon
props.desc: A leading icon/glyph.

props.name: iconVariant
props.desc: Icon tile style.

props.name: actions
props.desc: Action buttons row.

props.name: variant
props.desc: Bare vs carded.

props.name: align
props.desc: Alignment.

whenUse: A list / view with nothing in it yet.
An onboarding / connect prompt with a CTA.
whenNot: A transient loading state — use a skeleton.
An error — use InlineError / Banner.

components.name: StatusDot

props.name: state
props.desc: Session-state color.

props.name: color
props.desc: Custom color (overrides state).

props.name: size
props.desc: Diameter in px.

props.name: pulse
props.desc: Pulse animation.

props.name: title
props.desc: Native tooltip.

whenUse: A tiny live activity indicator beside a label.
Session / build state in a dense row.
whenNot: Conveying state by color alone — pair with text.
A large status graphic — use a Banner.

components.name: Skeleton

props.name: w
props.desc: Width — a px number or a CSS length string.

props.name: h
props.desc: Height — a px number or a CSS length string.

props.name: radius
props.desc: Corner radius in px.

whenUse: A shape-matched loading placeholder while content loads.
The loading state a content component renders for itself (#2302).
whenNot: An empty (no-data) state — use EmptyState.
An error — use InlineError / Banner.

components.name: MasterDetail

props.name: rail
props.desc: The master column — the list/nav rail.

props.name: detail
props.desc: The detail column — the selected item's editor/view.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Optional full-width toolbar/header above both columns.

props.name: railWidth
props.desc: Fixed rail width in px (the starting width when resizable).

props.name: railPad
props.desc: Rail inner padding — a rung/px or [block, inline] pair.

props.name: detailPad
props.desc: Detail inner padding — a rung/px or [block, inline] pair.

props.name: resizable
props.desc: Opt into a drag-resizable rail (a .resize-x splitter), bounded by railMin/railMax.

whenUse: A list/nav rail beside a detail view (Personas · Skills · MCP · GitHub · Security · Settings).
Any master→detail page where selecting a rail row drives the detail column.
whenNot: A free pan/zoom graph — use GraphCanvas.
A two-pane split with no fixed list rail — use SplitView.

components.name: SplitView

props.name: primary
props.desc: The flexing pane — fills the remaining space (terminal, editor, main content).

props.name: secondary
props.desc: The fixed-size, drag-resizable trailing pane (inspector, sidebar, detail).

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Optional full-width toolbar/header above the split.

props.name: orientation
props.desc: horizontal → side by side; vertical → primary above secondary.

props.name: resizable
props.desc: Draw the drag splitter (opt out for a fixed secondary), bounded by secondaryMin/secondaryMax.

props.name: secondarySize
props.desc: Secondary size in px (width when horizontal, height when vertical) — the starting size.

props.name: divider
props.desc: Draw the 1px divider border between the two panes.

whenUse: A resizable two-pane split (the planner session's terminal + inspector).
A main content area beside a fixed, draggable side panel.
whenNot: A fixed-width list rail + detail — use MasterDetail.
A grid of many equal panes — use PaneGrid.

components.name: GraphCanvas

props.name: vp
props.desc: The viewport created by the page's useGraphViewport().

props.name: world
props.desc: World (design-space) size { w, h } — drives the world layer's box.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Full toolbar content (search + palette + <ZoomControls vp={vp}/> + fit).

props.name: children
props.desc: World-layer content: grid, SVG edges, node cards — positioned in world coords.

props.name: rail
props.desc: Optional left rail/sidebar (feature-styled full node).

props.name: inspector
props.desc: Optional inspector column on the right (feature-styled full node).

props.name: dock
props.desc: Optional strip docked below the canvas (inside the content column, flex:none) — e.g. a docked session terminal. Caller owns its height/handle.

props.name: overlays
props.desc: Fixed overlays drawn over the canvas but NOT transformed (hints, legends).

props.name: grid
props.desc: Dotted graph-paper backdrop — an infinite grid on the viewport that tracks zoom + pan.

props.name: gridSize
props.desc: Grid tile size in world px (scaled by zoom on screen).

props.name: railResizable
props.desc: Make the left rail drag-resizable (a .resize-x splitter).

props.name: inspectorResizable
props.desc: Make the right inspector drag-resizable (splitter on its left edge).

props.name: onBackgroundClick
props.desc: Fires on a genuine click on the empty canvas backdrop (not a pan-drag end, not a node press).

whenUse: A pan/zoom graph workspace (Streams graph · Org designer · Glance).
Any node/edge canvas needing viewport wiring + an optional rail/inspector.
whenNot: A static list or form — use MasterDetail.
A CSS grid of equal panes — use PaneGrid.

components.name: PaneGrid

props.name: children
props.desc: The pane cells — N children laid across the grid tracks (cols × rows).

props.name: cols
props.desc: Column track count → repeat(cols, 1fr). Clamped to ≥ 1.

props.name: rows
props.desc: Row track count → repeat(rows, 1fr). Clamped to ≥ 1.

props.name: gap
props.desc: Gap between cells in px.

props.name: pad
props.desc: Grid inner padding in px.

props.name: hidden
props.desc: Render the grid display:none but keep it MOUNTED (children stay alive — the console cross-tab mount).

whenUse: A CSS grid of N equal panes (the Console tab grid).
A dashboard of equally-weighted tiles kept alive across tab switches (hidden).
whenNot: A single list+detail split — use MasterDetail.
A pan/zoom graph — use GraphCanvas.

components.name: Sequence

props.name: steps
props.desc: SequenceStep[] — ordered { id, label, status?, hint? }; array order IS the sequence. status: complete | active | upcoming | blocked (default upcoming).

props.name: detail
props.desc: The focus panel — a render prop receiving the focused step. Omit for a strip-only sequence.

props.name: orientation
props.desc: horizontal → stepper strip above the detail; vertical → timeline rail beside it.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Optional full-width toolbar/header above the sequence.

props.name: selectedId
props.desc: Controlled focused step id (pair with onSelect); omit for uncontrolled selection.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.desc: Uncontrolled initial focus — defaults to auto-following the active step, else the first.

props.name: onSelect
props.desc: Fires with the clicked step's id (both modes).

props.name: railWidth
props.desc: Timeline rail width in px (vertical only).

props.name: detailPad
props.desc: Detail inner padding — a rung/px or [block, inline] pair.

whenUse: Linked-list-shaped data where the prev→next ORDER is the first-class thing (workflows, pipelines, wizards, timelines).
A status-tracked stepper or timeline whose focused step drives a detail panel.
whenNot: An arbitrary node/edge graph — use GraphCanvas.
An unordered list beside a detail view — use MasterDetail.

components.name: Tree

props.name: nodes
props.desc: The tree roots — a recursive forest of TreeNodeData ({ id, label, meta?, children? }). Ids must be unique.

props.name: variant
props.desc: indented → collapsible rows + detail; layered → top-down pan/zoom chart.

props.name: detail
props.desc: Detail panel for the selected node — a node, or a render fn of the selected TreeNodeData. Indented: the detail column; layered: the canvas inspector.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Optional toolbar — full-width above (indented) / in the canvas toolbar row before the zoom cluster (layered).

props.name: selectedId
props.desc: Controlled selection — the selected node id (pair with onSelect). Omit for uncontrolled (defaultSelectedId).

props.name: onSelect
props.desc: Fires with the clicked node's id (both selection modes).

props.name: defaultCollapsedIds
props.desc: Indented: branch ids that start collapsed (expansion is uncontrolled). Default: all expanded.

props.name: onToggle
props.desc: Fires (id, expanded) when a branch expands/collapses.

props.name: indent
props.desc: Indented: px of indentation per depth level.

props.name: railWidth
props.desc: Indented: rail width in px (the starting width when resizable).

props.name: resizable
props.desc: Indented: opt into a drag-resizable rail (MasterDetail's .resize-x splitter).

whenUse: Deep / navigational tree data (file systems, category hierarchies) — variant="indented": collapsible depth-indented rows + a detail panel.
A presentational top-down hierarchy (org chart, ownership map) — variant="layered" rides the shared graph stack (layerDag + edge grammar + GraphCanvas pan/zoom).
whenNot: A flat list beside a detail — use MasterDetail.
A general (multi-parent / cyclic) graph — use GraphCanvas with layerDag directly.

components.name: LabelChip

props.name: label
props.desc: The GitHub label — { name, color } (6-hex, no leading #).

whenUse: A GitHub issue/PR label with its dynamic 6-hex color.
Label rows in issue drawers / project boards.
whenNot: A semantic status tag — use Chip with a tone.
A clickable filter — use SegmentedControl.

components.name: ActivityFeed

props.name: items
props.desc: ActivityItem[] — { login, action, target, repo, createdAt }.

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed hint after the card title.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Shimmer rows while the feed's source loads (only when items is empty).

props.name: tone
props.desc: action → color map — each caller keeps its own EVENT_TONE.

props.name: right
props.desc: Optional header control on the right (e.g. a filter select).

props.name: actionWidth
props.desc: Action column width in px (github uses 70, planner 80).

whenUse: A "Recent activity" card of actor · action · target rows.
Cross-repo / cross-project event feeds sharing one striped layout.
whenNot: A dense column-aligned table — use DataTableRow.
A single event notice — use Banner.
components.srcText:
import { ActivityFeed } from "@/shared/ui/data/ActivityFeed";

<ActivityFeed items={…} hint={…} loading={…} tone={…} />

components.name: KeyValueList

props.name: items
props.desc: KeyValueItem[] — the { k, v } rows, in display order.

props.name: labelWidth
props.desc: Fixed label column width in px.

props.name: mono
props.desc: Render values (not labels) in the mono font — ids, paths, config values.

props.name: loading
props.desc: Shimmer value placeholders (labels stay) while the record's source loads (#2302).

whenUse: A read-only label : value property list — a detail summary, config panel, or inspector facts block.
Rendering one record's named fields in a fixed, aligned two-column grid.
whenNot: Editable fields — use TextField / SelectField.
One headline metric — use StatTile.
Many homogeneous records — use DataTableRow / CardListRow.

components.name: Pane

props.name: mode
props.desc: Slide-over (scrim + slide-in) vs fills-its-container.

props.name: open
props.desc: Drawer mode: drives the scrim/slide state and gates the body render.

props.name: header
props.desc: Top-zone content (drawer mode auto-appends a close button).

props.name: body
props.desc: Body content — pass via body or as children.

props.name: children
props.desc: Body content (alias of body).

props.name: footer
props.desc: Custom footer; omitted in drawer mode → the standard draft/remove bar.

props.name: onClose
props.desc: Close (scrim click / ✕ / cancel / done) handler.

props.name: onRemove
props.desc: Standard-footer remove handler for an existing item.

props.name: isDraft
props.desc: Standard footer: drafting (cancel/done) vs existing (remove/done).

props.name: onCommit
props.desc: Standard-footer draft done handler.

props.name: commitDisabled
props.desc: Disable the draft done button (e.g. a required field is empty).

props.name: flush
props.desc: Drop the body's default padding (sections supply their own).

props.name: bare
props.desc: Inline mode only: bare flex-column frame with no styled zone wrappers.

props.name: className
props.desc: Extra class on the frame element.

whenUse: A select-an-item → edit-its-fields surface: slide-over drawer or inline master-detail pane.
Editors needing the standard draft/remove footer.
whenNot: A blocking decision or short form — use Dialog.
Static grouped content — use Card.

components.name: TelemetryPanel

props.name: title
props.desc: Panel title (mono h3).

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed hint after the title.

props.name: right
props.desc: Right-aligned header content (a legend, a filter, a count).

props.name: children
props.desc: Content.

whenUse: The framed panel around an analytics chart (title · hint · right slot).
Analytics tabs sharing the telemetry card chrome.
whenNot: A KPI number — use StatCard.
General grouped content — use Card.

components.name: ItemBars

props.name: rows
props.desc: ItemBarRow[] — { key, label, meta?, value, fraction (0–1), color? }.

props.name: empty
props.desc: Rendered when rows is empty; defaults to a "No data recorded yet." hint.

whenUse: A labelled per-item meter list (calls per server, fires per hook).
Ranked fractions where each row carries a label + value.
whenNot: An SVG ranked bar chart with a shared axis — use HBars.
One fraction — use FillBar.

components.name: SplitBar

props.name: label
props.desc: Row label.

props.name: a
props.desc: First-segment count.

props.name: b
props.desc: Second-segment count.

props.name: aLabel
props.desc: First-segment legend label (e.g. ok).

props.name: bLabel
props.desc: Second-segment legend label (e.g. err).

props.name: aColor
props.desc: First-segment color.

props.name: bColor
props.desc: Second-segment color.

whenUse: A two-way proportion with its counts (ok/err, allow/block).
Per-item health rows in an analytics panel.
whenNot: More than two segments — use Donut / Bars.
A single fill fraction — use FillBar.
components.srcText:
import { SplitBar } from "@/shared/ui/charts/telemetry";

<SplitBar label={…} a={…} b={…} aLabel={…} bLabel={…} />

components.name: TablePage

props.name: title
props.desc: Page title (the header bar).

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed inline hint after the title.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Right-aligned header controls (search, filters, actions).

props.name: columns
props.desc: TablePageColumn[] — { key, label, width? }; order is display order, `key` addresses the row cells.

props.name: rows
props.desc: TablePageRow[] — { id, cells: Record<key, ReactNode> }, in display order.

props.name: selectedId
props.desc: Controlled selection — the selected row id (pair with onSelect). Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.desc: Uncontrolled: the initially selected row id.

props.name: onSelect
props.desc: Fires with the clicked row's id (both selection modes).

props.name: detail
props.desc: Detail panel override — a render fn of the selected row. Default: a KeyValueList of the row's cells.

props.name: detailWidth
props.desc: Detail (SplitView secondary) width in px.

whenUse: A complete records browser: columnar rows from typed columns × rows, with a selected-record inspector.
Any dataset whose fields align under fixed column labels (runs, issues, sessions).
whenNot: Card-styled list items with rich slots — use CollectionPage.
Just the row primitive inside your own frame — use DataTableRow directly.

components.name: TreeExplorerPage

props.name: title
props.desc: Page title (the header bar).

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed inline hint after the title.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Right-aligned header controls (search, filters, actions).

props.name: nodes
props.desc: The tree roots — a recursive forest of TreeNodeData ({ id, label, meta?, children? }). Ids must be unique.

props.name: selectedId
props.desc: Controlled selection — the selected node id (pair with onSelect). Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.desc: Uncontrolled: the initially selected node id.

props.name: onSelect
props.desc: Fires with the clicked node's id (both selection modes).

props.name: defaultCollapsedIds
props.desc: Branch ids that start collapsed (expansion is uncontrolled). Default: all expanded.

props.name: detail
props.desc: Detail panel override — a render fn of the selected node. Default: the node's facts as a KeyValueList.

props.name: nodeFacts
props.desc: Extra KeyValueItem[] appended to the default detail, derived from the selected node.

props.name: railWidth
props.desc: Rail width in px.

whenUse: A complete hierarchy explorer: collapsible indented rows beside a node-facts detail panel.
Deep navigational trees (file systems, category hierarchies) that deserve a whole page.
whenNot: A presentational top-down chart — use Tree variant="layered" (or NetworkPage for general graphs).
Just the tree rail inside your own frame — use Tree directly.

components.name: PipelinePage

props.name: title
props.desc: Page title (the header bar).

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed inline hint after the title.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Right-aligned header controls (search, filters, actions).

props.name: steps
props.desc: PipelineStep[] — ordered SequenceStep ({ id, label, status?, hint? }) plus { description?, facts? }; array order IS the pipeline.

props.name: orientation
props.desc: horizontal → stepper strip above the detail; vertical → timeline rail beside it.

props.name: selectedId
props.desc: Controlled selection — the selected step id (pair with onSelect). Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.desc: Uncontrolled: the initially selected step id.

props.name: onSelect
props.desc: Fires with the clicked step's id (both selection modes).

props.name: detail
props.desc: Detail panel override — a render fn of the selected step. Default: heading + status Chip + description + facts KeyValueList.

whenUse: A complete pipeline/workflow page: the status-colored step strip driving a focused-step detail (status Chip + description + facts).
Deploy pipelines, wizards, and timelines where prev→next order is the page's subject.
whenNot: An arbitrary node/edge graph — use NetworkPage.
Just the step strip inside your own frame — use Sequence directly.

components.name: NetworkPage

props.name: title
props.desc: Page title (the toolbar row).

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed inline hint after the title.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Extra toolbar controls, before the zoom cluster.

props.name: nodes
props.desc: NetworkNodeData[] — { id, label, meta? }. Ids must be unique.

props.name: edges
props.desc: NetworkEdgeData[] — directed { from, to, id? }; cycles are fine (layering breaks them, drawing keeps them).

props.name: selectedId
props.desc: Controlled selection — the selected node id (pair with onSelect). Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.desc: Uncontrolled: the initially selected node id.

props.name: onSelect
props.desc: Fires with the clicked node's id (both selection modes).

props.name: detail
props.desc: Detail panel override — a render fn of the selected node. Default: label + facts (id · meta · in/out degree) as a KeyValueList.

props.name: inspectorWidth
props.desc: Inspector width in px when a node is selected.

whenUse: A complete graph workspace: pan/zoom node cards + directional edges from typed { nodes, edges }, with a selected-node inspector.
Dependency / coordination networks laid out by the shared graph stack (cycles tolerated).
whenNot: A strict single-parent hierarchy — use TreeExplorerPage (or Tree layered).
A custom world (bespoke nodes, drag) — use GraphCanvas + the shared graph libs directly.

components.name: DashboardPage

props.name: title
props.desc: Page title (the header bar).

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed inline hint after the title.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Right-aligned header controls (range toggle, filters).

props.name: stats
props.desc: DashboardStat[] — { k, v, sub?, tone?, trend?, trendColor? }, in display order.

props.name: trend
props.desc: The trend chart card — { title, hint?, labels, series: LineSeries[] }. Omit to drop the card.

props.name: breakdown
props.desc: The breakdown donut card — { title, hint?, slices: DonutSlice[] }. Omit to drop the card.

props.name: activity
props.desc: The activity column — { hint, items: ActivityItem[], tone }. Omit to drop the column.

whenUse: A complete metrics board: KPI stat tiles (inline Spark trends), a LineArea trend card, a Donut breakdown card, and an activity column.
Project / fleet health overviews rendered entirely from typed stats + series + slices + events.
whenNot: One metric or one chart — use StatCard / a chart primitive in a Card.
Records the user drills into — use TablePage or CollectionPage.

components.name: CollectionPage

props.name: title
props.desc: Page title (the header bar).

props.name: hint
props.desc: Dimmed inline hint after the title.

props.name: toolbar
props.desc: Right-aligned header controls (search, filters, actions).

props.name: items
props.desc: CollectionItem[] — { id, title, subtitle?, badge?, badgeTone?, meta?, facts? }, in display order.

props.name: selectedId
props.desc: Controlled selection — the selected item id (pair with onSelect). Omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.desc: Uncontrolled: the initially selected item id.

props.name: onSelect
props.desc: Fires with the clicked item's id (both selection modes).

props.name: detail
props.desc: Detail panel override — a render fn of the selected item. Default: title + subtitle + facts KeyValueList.

props.name: railWidth
props.desc: Rail width in px.

whenUse: A complete master→detail collection page: CardListRow items (badge Chip, subtitle, trailing meta) beside an item-facts detail.
Libraries and registries (personas, skills, servers) whose items carry rich row slots.
whenNot: Field-aligned columnar records — use TablePage.
Just the list rail inside your own frame — use MasterDetail + CardListRow directly.

components.name: RecordPage

props.name: title
props.desc: The record's identity — the page title (the header bar).

props.name: subtitle
props.desc: Dimmed identity sub-text after the title (the header hint slot).

props.name: status
props.desc: A status Chip label rendered beside the title (e.g. "running", "archived").

props.name: statusTone
props.desc: Status Chip tone.

props.name: actions
props.desc: Right-aligned header actions (edit, open, delete).

props.name: sections
props.desc: RecordSection[] — { label, entries: { k, v }[] }, in display order; each renders as a SectionLabel over a KeyValueList.

props.name: aside
props.desc: Optional side column (facts, related items) beside the sections.

props.name: asideWidth
props.desc: Side column width in px.

whenUse: A complete record-detail page for ONE keyed record: an identity header (status Chip, subtitle, actions) over grouped label : value sections.
Config/property inspectors, session or entity detail views whose subject is a single record's fields.
whenNot: Many records the user picks from — use CollectionPage (or TablePage for columnar fields).
Just the property list inside your own frame — use KeyValueList directly.
